title: Big Stars to Headline Glastonbury 2027
summary:
Glastonbury is back! Next summer, big music stars will play at the famous festival on a farm in Pilton.

Harry Styles, Billie Eilish, Cher and Sam Fender will be the headliners. The festival will run from 23 to 27 June 2027. It will be Harry Styles's first time headlining Glastonbury. Billie Eilish will top the bill for the second time. Cher, who has not toured since 2020, will take the special legends slot on Sunday night.

Other acts include Massive Attack, Lily Allen, Robyn, the XX, Chvrches, Kacey Musgraves, Lola Young, Sombr and Adéla.

Festival organiser Emily Eavis shared the news on Instagram. She said the team was happy to return after a fallow year, a year off that lets the fields rest. More names will be announced in the new year.

Tickets cost £408, the first time the price has gone past £400. That is up from £378.50 in 2025. Tickets sold out instantly on 4 October.

Oasis and Madonna will not headline. Madonna is heading to Coachella in April, while Oasis start their own global tour in May.
why_it_matters: Music festivals bring your favourite singers together in one place, so knowing who is playing helps you spot the stars you love.
